title: fix(html): select matching option in fill_form for single-valued select

files.patch:
@@ -34,6 +34,10 @@ Bugs fixed
 * GH#543: Repeated ElementPath searches could leak an index counter into the next run since lxml 7.0.
   Patch by Nayana-Naik73.
 
+* GH#545: ``lxml.html.fill_form()`` now selects the matching ``<option>`` of a single-valued ``<select>``
+  instead of setting a ``value`` attribute on the ``<select>`` element.
+  Patch by Alex Castillo Gonzalez.
+
 * Parsing from a file path in the soupparser did not close the file it opened.
 
 * LP#2165904: Content of PIs and comments set through their ``.text`` property was not validated.

@@ -117,8 +117,11 @@ def _select(el, select):
             del el.attrib['selected']
 
 def _fill_single(input, value):
-    if _nons(input.tag) == 'textarea':
+    input_tag_name = _nons(input.tag)
+    if input_tag_name == 'textarea':
         input.text = value
+    elif input_tag_name == 'select':
+        _fill_multiple(input, [value])
     else:
         input.set('value', value)

@@ -110,3 +110,23 @@ be removed. The "name" attribute should be kept::
     <form>
       <textarea name="foo">Bar</textarea>
     </form>
+
+
+A single-valued ``<select>`` (without ``multiple``) gets the matching
+``<option>`` selected, and the other options are deselected::
+
+    >>> print(fill_form_html('''
+    ... <form>
+    ...   <select name="colour">
+    ...     <option value="red" selected>Red</option>
+    ...     <option value="blue">Blue</option>
+    ...     <option>green</option>
+    ...   </select>
+    ... </form>''', dict(colour="blue")))
+    <form>
+      <select name="colour">
+        <option value="red">Red</option>
+        <option value="blue" selected>Blue</option>
+        <option>green</option>
+      </select>
+    </form>
